page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with two centred quotations below it. Below the quotations is a centred woodcut emblem. A gathering signature sits at the lower right of the text block. No marginal notes. The page edge of the neighbouring page at the right is not transcribed.

main_text.p: etiam nullo intercedente humano externoque discursu : Etenim si creaturæ rebus externis undique circumstrepentibus circumcinctæ, eisque applicatæ, nimisque occupatæ, malo peccatoque penetratæ, hoc nihilominus gratiæ præstat Creator, ut in illo statu copiam atque ideam sui, quam deduximus, mirandam sane, excitet, & magis magisque promoveat, utendo vel ipsis rebus externis & imperfectis, literis, characteribus, sonis, quæ nexum necessarium cum illo non habent, imo ipsismet imperfectionibus à quibus abhorret; multo magis cum illa istis erit libera & vacua solique Creatori dedita, Hic Illi Ideam sui & Copiam per se, istis velis remotis, immediate impressurus & aucturus[?] censendus est.

p.i: O Deus, quis Similis Tibi? Psal. 71: 19.
Nullus plane est sicut Tu, Domine. Jerem. x. 6.

page.notes: Underlined in the original: "utendo vel ipsis rebus externis & imperfectis, literis, characteribus, sonis, quæ nexum necessarium cum illo non habent, imo ipsismet imperfectionibus à quibus abhorret". Underlining is not italic, so it is not marked in the text. Centred woodcut emblem below the quotations, showing a cartouche with two winged figures or putti at the sides, flowers and fruit in the centre, and scrollwork below. It has no printed words. "aucturus" is read with [?] because the word is partly obscured by the spine shadow and the letters are hard to separate. Faint mirrored text (show-through from the other side) lies beneath the main text block and was left out. The signature "L I." is printed at the lower right of the text block.
